NET-01.title: Admin or database port open to the internet
NET-01.fix: Limit the source to VPN or bastion ranges, or use SSM, Azure Bastion or IAP.

STO-01.title: Storage bucket grants public access
STO-01.fix: Remove the public grant and turn on Block Public Access or Public Access Prevention.

DB-02.title: Database firewall open to the whole internet
DB-02.fix: Delete the any-address rule. Use private networking.

DB-01.title: Database has a public network path
DB-01.fix: Confirm the business need. Otherwise move to a private endpoint.

STO-02.title: Storage account permits anonymous blob access
STO-02.fix: Set allow blob public access to false.

ENC-01.title: Disk not encrypted
ENC-01.fix: Create an encrypted copy, swap it in and enable encryption by default.

COST-01.title: Unattached disk
COST-01.fix: Snapshot if needed, get owner approval, then delete.

COST-02.title: Idle public IP
COST-02.fix: Confirm nothing depends on the address, then release it.
